title: DON'T EVEN THINK ABOUT IT!!!
text:
DON'T EVEN THINK ABOUT IT!!!. This is a piece of junk. The only way I could make it marginally work was to tape up three of the four cigarette rests. Also, the rests themselves are worthless. They don't grip a cigarette, so if you don't pay attention the cig will go out if it rests with the tip in the ashtray or fall off if the cig is too short and burn whatever surface the ashtray is resting on.
I used it for less than two days and then threw it away.

product_metadata.title: Smokeless Ashtray, 2 Pcs Carbon Filters Included
description: Keep the smoke out of the airThis is truly the highest quality, most effective smokeless ashtray. It uses an advanced Japanese design, which draws the smoke through two replaceable carbon filters located inside the ashtray. It's super quiet, and eliminates the smoke, smell, and ash dust.If you smoke, live with someone who smokes, or smoke and live with someone who doesn't smoke, this is a must have. Keep the smoke out of the air, off furniture, clothes, pets, your own face, and other people. Features:   Super quiet operation   Tilted grooves on all 4 sides, one large and 6 small to fit cigars and cigarettes   8 Auto-extinguishers   Comes complete with a set of activated carbon charcoal filters, which will last for more than 40 days  Easy to clean, Top lifts right off (See diagram)   Powered by 2 C Batteries (not included)
